description:
CFB GameDay Board puts the whole college football slate on one screen.

BEFORE KICKOFF
- Every FBS game with kickoff time in US Central
- Venue, city, elevation, and a one-tap map
- Kickoff-hour weather at the stadium: temperature, wind, rain chance, humidity, with flags for heat, wind, rain, and altitude
- TV network and streaming service
- Publicly posted point spread, total, and moneyline with the implied final score

DURING THE GAMES
- Live scores, clock, down and distance, last play, red-zone marker
- Whether the favorite is covering and what the total needs, updated every 30 seconds
- A live desk that lists only the games in progress

RIVALRY GAMES
- Every trophy game is marked on its card, from the Iron Bowl and The Game to the Old Oaken Bucket and the Wagon Wheel
- A rivalry desk lists the day's trophy games, and the Rivalry filter shows the whole week's

GAME SHEET
- Tap Game on any live or final game for the scoring summary, team box score, passing, rushing and receiving leaders, every drive, and ESPN's win probability chart

FILTERS
- Day, time window, conference, ranked only, rivalry games, weather-impact only, starred only, all behind one Filters button
- Lines sheet, by-network board, and a landslide board for the biggest spreads
- Search by team, stadium, city, TV, or conference

WIDGETS
- Home Screen widgets in three sizes, plus two for the Lock Screen: the day's games with live scores, kickoff times, TV, and the kickoff forecast
- Show every game, only the Top 25, or only rivalry games, and tap a live or final game to open its game sheet

QUICK ACTIONS AND LINKS
- Long-press the app icon for Live Games, your Starred games, By TV (every game grouped by network), or Rivalry Games
- Links to cfbgameday.app open straight in the app

ON IPAD AND MAC
- Two or three columns on a wide screen, in any orientation
- A resizable window on Apple silicon Macs
- Keyboard shortcuts: Command-1 to 4 switch tabs, Command-F searches, Command-R reloads

DATA
Scores, schedules, and posted lines come from ESPN's public scoreboard. Weather comes from Open-Meteo. No account, no sign-in, no ads.

CFB GameDay Board is an information display. It is not a sportsbook, it does not accept wagers or payments, and it is not betting advice.
